tools.name: purchase_workspace_seats
tools.description: Buys additional paid member seats for the workspace and charges the workspace's card on file. Returns the seat count after purchase and the amount charged, along with the current seat usage.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: ID of the workspace to add seats to

tools.code:
import os
import stripe
import sqlite3
from langchain_core.tools import tool

stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_API_KEY"]
PRICE_PER_SEAT_CENTS = 800


@tool
def purchase_workspace_seats(workspace_id: str, additional_seat_count: int) -> str:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect("workspace.db")
    billing_row = database_connection.execute(
        "SELECT stripe_customer_id, seat_limit, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM members WHERE workspace_id = ?) FROM workspaces WHERE id = ?",
        (workspace_id, workspace_id),
    ).fetchone()
    database_connection.close()
    if billing_row is None:
        return "Workspace not found"
    stripe_customer_identifier, current_seat_limit, current_member_count = billing_row
    total_amount_in_cents = PRICE_PER_SEAT_CENTS * additional_seat_count
    payment_intent_object = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=total_amount_in_cents,
        currency="usd",
        customer=stripe_customer_identifier,
        confirm=True,
        description=f"{additional_seat_count} extra seats for {workspace_id}",
    )
    return f"Charged {total_amount_in_cents} cents (status {payment_intent_object.status}); seats now {current_seat_limit + additional_seat_count}, members {current_member_count}"

tools.name: run_channel_export_and_notify
tools.description: Runs the export script for a channel's history and then posts the resulting archive link to a webhook URL. Returns the script exit status and the webhook response status.

params.name: channel_id
params.description: ID of the channel to export

params.name: output_dir
params.description: Directory where the export script writes the archive

params.name: webhook_url
params.description: Webhook URL that receives the archive notification

params.name: days_back
params.description: Number of days of history to export

tools.code:
import subprocess
import sys
import requests

EXPORT_SCRIPT = "/opt/chat/scripts/export_channel.py"


def run_channel_export_and_notify(channel_id: str, output_dir: str, webhook_url: str, days_back: int = 30) -> dict:
    result = {
        "channel_id": channel_id,
        "export_ok": False,
        "exit_code": None,
        "stderr": "",
        "webhook_status": None,
        "archive_path": None,
    }
    command = [
        sys.executable,
        EXPORT_SCRIPT,
        "--channel",
        channel_id,
        "--out",
        output_dir,
        "--days",
        str(days_back),
    ]
    completed = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600)
    result["exit_code"] = completed.returncode
    result["stderr"] = completed.stderr[-500:]
    if completed.returncode != 0:
        return result
    lines = completed.stdout.strip().splitlines()
    archive_path = lines[-1] if lines else None
    result["export_ok"] = True
    result["archive_path"] = archive_path
    payload = {
        "text": f"Export of channel {channel_id} finished",
        "archive": archive_path,
        "days": days_back,
    }
    try:
        response = requests.post(webhook_url, json=payload, timeout=15)
        result["webhook_status"] = response.status_code
    except requests.RequestException as error:
        result["webhook_status"] = str(error)
    return result

tools.name: run_message_reindex
tools.description: Starts the search reindex job for a channel so its messages become searchable again.

params.name: channel_id
params.description: ID of the channel to reindex

tools.code:
import subprocess
from agents import function_tool


@function_tool
def run_message_reindex(channel_id: str) -> str:
    p = subprocess.run(
        ["/opt/chat/bin/reindex", "--channel", channel_id],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=900,
    )
    return f"exit {p.returncode}: {p.stdout[-200:]}"
